name: reverser
description: Evidence-driven Android and native reverse engineering with Droid ASC, JADX, and headless Ghidra MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Android and native binaries safely
interface.longDescription: Analyze APK and DEX files with Droid ASC or isolated JADX, follow JNI boundaries into native libraries, and inspect binaries through a loopback-only headless Ghidra MCP service.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this APK and record reproducible evidence.
Trace this JNI boundary into the native library.
Inspect this binary through headless Ghidra.
